name: app-website
description: Builds a one-page app introduction website using SwiftUI-For-Web (github.com/ShawnBaek/SwiftUI-For-Web) and Gridlover-style vertical rhythm. Sections: About/Hero, Key Features with iPhone-framed screenshots, parallax product showcase, Download (App Store badges), Share. Typography-first aesthetic inspired by developer.apple.com/swiftui and airbnb.com. The agent forces SwiftUI-For-Web usage so the indie dev's website code stays declarative and feels like the SwiftUI codebase it markets.
